steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Deploys and rollbacks are placed in the order they happened.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Failed production deploy with no cause
findings.fix: Record the cause and the fix

findings.title: Production deploy with no approval reference
findings.fix: Attach the approval or record the exception

outcome.notChecked: What happened in production after the deploy.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] deploy-search.log:12  Failed production deploy with no cause.
       Fix: Record the cause and the fix.
[high] deploy-billing.log:19  Production deploy with no approval reference.
       Fix: Attach the approval or record the exception.
[medium] deploy-worker.log:26  Rollback with no record.
       Fix: Write the rollback entry.
Not checked: What happened in production after the deploy.
pros: Flags a failed deployment with no cause, a rollback with no record, and a deployment to production with no approval reference.
cons: Not checked: What happened in production after the deploy.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-deploy-log skill on the records for this review.
